title: OpenAI Product Head Tibo: Daily Improvements or Full Usage Reset for 28 Days
source_used: 36Kr (WeChat account Synced / Almost Human), found via search; ABAB News page had no readable text
key_facts: Tibo, an OpenAI executive active on X, promised 28 consecutive days of releases or resets.
He said OpenAI has locked in four areas: simplifying products, improving efficiency to support more usage, delivering breakthrough features, and launching new models.
The article says users are questioning whether to trust the promise after OpenAI’s Developers Day.
Heavy users complained of reduced quotas and slower models after Developers Day, per the article.
About 20 new things were previewed before Developers Day, including GPT-6.1 Sol, Codex / Work updates and Dots.
A user on the SpaceXAI Grok Bot team publicly needled OpenAI; Tibo answered.
ABAB News headline calls the alternative to daily improvements a full usage reset.
quote_evidence: Not long after, he previewed again that there will be 28 consecutive days of releases or resets, and emphasized “features that are obviously improved and practical for users”.
After the Developers Day, OpenAI is going through a user trust crisis.
why_it_matters_hint: OpenAI is under pressure from heavy users over usage limits and uneven product quality.
event_date: Posts by Tibo around 4 to 5 Oct 2026
notes: ABAB News page had no readable text; 36Kr commentary (republished from Synced) read instead. It is opinion-heavy and its “trust crisis” framing is the author’s view. Meaning of “reset” is taken from the ABAB headline (usage reset), not defined in 36Kr text.
